name: Fairmont Mount Kenya Safari Club
positioning: Fairmont Mount Kenya Safari Club, a hotel opened in 1959 at the foothills of Mount Kenya, within the Mount Kenya Wildlife Conservancy
best_for: Travelers who want wildlife conservation and a Mount Kenya setting
Families or groups wanting a villa or two-bedroom suite

facts.text: The hotel sits at the foothills of Mount Kenya, within the Mount Kenya Wildlife Conservancy.
The hotel is in Nanyuki, Kenya, just a few miles from the Equator.
The hotel was opened by the actor William Holden in 1959 at the base of Mount Kenya.
The rooms, suites and villas blend 1950s charm with modern comfort.
The Fairmont Deluxe rooms have a living area with a sofa and a fireplace.
Batian Villa is a two-bedroom house in a garden with a view of Mount Kenya.
The William Holden Two-Bedroom Suites have a lounge with a fireplace and views of Mount Kenya, birdlife and llamas on the lawns.
Dining includes breakfasts at Tusks and sundowner cocktails at the Zebar Terrace.
The hotel has an outdoor heated pool.
The hotel offers an eco safari horse riding experience.

highlights.text: A breakfast with a live cooking experience is offered while observing the critically endangered Mountain Bongos at the Mount Kenya Wildlife Conservancy.
Guests can witness the rewilding of the critically endangered Mountain Bongo and visit the on-site Wildlife Rescue Center.
The hotel shares its grounds with the Mount Kenya Wildlife Rescue Center, and guests have exclusive access to it.
The hotel has its own airstrip for private charters.

considerations.text: Jomo Kenyatta International Airport in Nairobi is about a 3-hour drive from the hotel.
The spa has three treatment rooms, so it is a small spa.
WhataHotel notes the cool highland climate may not suit all travelers.
